sentences.text: Social worker Fiona Grant (S1) is conducting a review of Edna Holloway's (S2) care situation.
Edna Holloway (S2) recalls a previous visit by Fiona Grant (S1) in the summer.
Senior care worker Joy Mensah (S3) is present for the meeting.
Edna Holloway (S2) states that Joy Mensah (S3) does her hair.
Senior care worker Joy Mensah (S3) clarifies that Joy only does Edna's hair on Thursdays.
Edna Holloway (S2) states she finds the food 'alright' but 'bit bland'.
Edna Holloway (S2) states she likes the lounge and can see the garden from there.
Edna Holloway (S2) states she uses a frame to get about.
Edna Holloway (S2) states Joy Mensah (S3) or one of the girls walks her to the dining room.
Senior care worker Joy Mensah (S3) states that Edna has been 'really steady' since the physio in September.
Edna Holloway (S2) states her left hearing aid 'whistles'.
Senior care worker Joy Mensah (S3) states an audiology appointment is booked for the 8th of December.
Edna Holloway (S2) states her daughter Pauline is still phoning every Sunday.
Edna Holloway (S2) states Pauline lives in Inverness and 'can't get down much'.
Senior care worker Joy Mensah (S3) reports an incident occurred on the night of Saturday the 14th of November.
Senior care worker Joy Mensah (S3) reports that resident Mr Pike (Arthur Pike) was in Edna Holloway's bed at 2.30 on the night of the 14th of November.
Senior care worker Joy Mensah (S3) reports Mr Pike was in the bed 'under the covers, next to her'.
Senior care worker Joy Mensah (S3) reports Edna Holloway (S2) was awake and 'upset', saying 'get off'.
Senior care worker Joy Mensah (S3) reports she got Mr Pike up, walked him back to his room, sat with Edna, and wrote the incident in the incident book.
Edna Holloway (S2) states she woke up and there was a man in her bed.
Edna Holloway (S2) states the man 'touched me' on her bottom and front 'under my nightie'.
Edna Holloway (S2) states she told the man to stop, saying 'stop it, get out' 'a lot of times'.
Edna Holloway (S2) states Mr Pike did not stop 'straight away'.
Edna Holloway (S2) states she does not sleep well and keeps the light on now.
Edna Holloway (S2) states this incident was the first time Mr Pike came into her room.
Senior care worker Joy Mensah (S3) states there is nothing in the records about Mr Pike going into her room before the incident.
Senior care worker Joy Mensah (S3) reports she told Mrs Dobson (the manager) on the Monday morning after writing the incident book.
Senior care worker Joy Mensah (S3) reports Mrs Dobson stated Mr Pike was confused and 'just went into the wrong room'.
Senior care worker Joy Mensah (S3) reports Mrs Dobson stated it 'didn't need reporting' and told her 'not to make a fuss'.
Senior care worker Joy Mensah (S3) reports she called Edna Holloway (S2) because the incident was not reported to anyone outside the home.
